name: cassiobotaro-skills
description: Agent skills for software architecture, engineering, communication, and learning

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Write and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in the Michael Nygard format, file-compatible with Nat Pryce's adr-tools and importable into Structurizr's decision log even when written in another language

plugins.name: design-doc
plugins.description: Write and review software design documents through interactive discovery: targeted questions about problem, trade-offs, alternatives, and impacted teams, producing trade-off-focused Markdown

plugins.name: structurizr
plugins.description: Author, evolve, and validate C4 model architecture documentation as Structurizr DSL (workspace.dsl): system context, container, component, deployment, and dynamic diagrams

plugins.name: mermaid-sequence
plugins.description: Write and edit Mermaid sequence diagrams as fenced code blocks that render directly in Markdown (GitHub, GitLab, most wikis)

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Remove machine-writing patterns from prose in English or Brazilian Portuguese without changing its meaning or adding facts; runs only when you ask for it by name or another skill calls it

plugins.name: code-comments
plugins.description: Keep the comments in code an agent writes or changes useful, precise, and compact, following The Art of Readable Code: comment what the reader cannot get from the code, never what they can

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Explain a topic to one specific reader and write clear messages, emails, and replies, choosing the device by the reader's situation: a worked example, a mapped analogy with its limit, a wrong idea named and corrected, the request first
